description: Appendix G Information is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Appendix G Information dataset provides insight on Northern Powergrid's contracted position with NESO for relevant embedded power stations connected and accepted to be connected to the distribution system. The data includes MW capacities, constraint indications and the latest connection dates based on current grid reinforcement works required per GSP. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Connecting Demand, Connecting Generation. Its keywords are Connections, Extra High Voltage (EHV), National Grid, Generation. The portal shows 2025-05-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
